profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm interested in working in a fast-paced environment where I'm constantly challenged to learn new skills.  I would be especially interested in hearing about positions in the technology industry.  I want to work on something that I can be proud of!

My previous job involved C++ development on a distributed low-latency trading system.  I was responsible for all aspects of my projects from gathering requirements through testing and release.

While it's true that I have worked primarily in C++ over the past several years, I am willing to learn any new language or technology.  I would be particularly interested in moving in the direction of web and/or mobile development as that is the future of technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
ExtraHop is a cybersecurity company providing AI-based network intelligence that stops advanced threats across cloud, hybrid, and distributed environments.

Responsibilities/accomplishments:

Wrote low-latency parsers for various network protocols in C and C++
Reverse-engineered various Microsoft wire protocols
Designed and built a system to decrypt live NTLM and SMB traffic
Secret-sharing to allow live decryption of PFS traffic, including packet and secret logging
Worked with data science team to define and implement useful protocol metrics for threat detection
Built REST backend handlers in Go
Built various pieces of web backend in Python/DJango
Built an automated reporting system

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
AllJoyn is an open-source framework for IoE devices.

In December 2013 control of AllJoyn was transferred to the AllSeen Alliance, a Linux Foundation Collaborative Project.

I worked on the platform-agnostic​ C++ library and the thin client C implementation for embedded devices.

- Worked on AllJoyn, a distributed software bus for mobile applications
- Built and debugged AllJoyn thin client for embedded devices
- Ported thin client to various platforms
- Built a reliable UDP transport for embedded platforms based on RFC 908 and 1151
- Designed system for onboarding new devices to user’s home network
- Wrote serial protocol for embedded AllJoyn-based devices
- Built a framework for IOT Smart Lighting
- Filed two patents related to IOT related to onboarding and proximity detection

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
RTS is a software vendor catering to the trading and financial industry.  Their products include algorithmic trading engines, various trading GUI's, an order matching system, and exchange interfaces to over 140 trading venues worldwide.  RTS also provides hosting in data centers around the world.

- Transitioned legacy trading system from point-to-point transport to bus-based distributed architecture
- Implemented transport layer with Informatica LBM
- Improved performance of market data feeds
- Bug fixes and new features in various legacy programs

company.name: RTS Realtime Systems (now a part of Bloomberg)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Sun was a privately held high-frequency proprietary trading firm.  They trade a variety of asset classes across multiple venues in the United States and Europe.

- Developed high-performance order matching system with order gateways
- Wrote several trading strategy modes
- Developed various trading microservices for a distributed low-latency high-frequency trading system
- Managed the full rollout of connectivity to several new trading venues
- Optimized and refactored several old system components
- Tested performance of all new code before release to production

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Mintel is a London-based market research firm that provides web access to research data.  Customers are able to create custom reports and view trends online.

- Worked with Apache C++ modules in a UNIX (BSD) environment
- Maintained customer survey site implemented in PHP and MySQL
- Wrote backend scripts in perl and bash
- Maintained MySQL databases for various client-facing websites
- Participated in code reviews to ensure proper design and implementation
- Acted as intermediary between product manager and IT project manager
- Worked with development team in London to standardize internal technology

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed GUI with Swing using Borland JBuilder
- Tested and debugged a mission-critical software project
- Parsed and processed XML data with XERCES
- Project was used for financial analysis of power usage in Eastern Africa

company.name: Purdue University Department of Industrial Engineering
